high_level_description: The image shows a wooden cabinet with a rich, dark brown finish. The cabinet has a single drawer at the top with a round, metallic knob. Below the drawer is a door with four decorative tiles embedded into it. Each tile features intricate floral patterns with vibrant colors such as yellow, red, blue, and green. The tiles are arranged in a 2x2 grid. The top left tile displays a large yellow flower with green leaves on a blue background. The top right tile has a geometric pattern with a central yellow flower surrounded by smaller red flowers on a blue background.
